caption: Quiet workout apartment edition: five strength moves with zero noise, for training while a child sleeps on the other side of the wall. Two rounds, ten minutes, not one creak.

voiceover.text: She fell asleep at eight. The floor creaks.
The workout industry assumes you can jump. You cannot.
So here are five moves with zero sound.
Glute bridges. Ten reps. Your hips do the work.
Wall sit. Thirty seconds. Perfectly still, working hard.
Wall push-ups. Ten reps. Quiet as breathing.
Lying heel taps. Ten each side. Slow.
Knee plank. Twenty-five seconds. Not one creak.
Two rounds. Ten minutes. The door never opens.
That was a full session. She never stirred.
You trained hard in total silence. That is skill.
Your strength does not need a loud room.
Tomorrow this fits between two meetings. Desk clothes on.
Who is asleep on the other side of your wall?

overlays.text: These five moves make zero noise.
Start with ten slow glute bridges.
Wall sit for thirty silent seconds.
Ten wall push-ups, quiet as breathing.
Heel taps, then a knee plank.
Two rounds. The door never opens.
